source.title: Fish in a Barrel
source.description:
I served in Hearthglen for a time, and I cannot tell you how utterly terrifying it was relying on deliveries from across the Plaguelands to keep us fed. New Avalon having a stable supply chain by sea has been a blessing, at least until very recently.

In yet another case of "Carrie is trying to feed an army with a kitchen stocked for a family", I am in need of fish. Check the dock down south to see if my order has arrived.
source.objective: Investigate the boat docked south of New Avalon for a shipment of fish and return a haul back to Carrie.
source.progress: Did I mention that I hate the smell of fish? Maybe I should ask you to grab a clothespin while you're out.
source.completion:
I don't recognize a few of these, but a fish is a fish I suppose. Either way, I am already looking forward to having all of this out of my kitchen.

Thank you for your help, even if this was a task I actually hoped you would have returned empty handed.
